```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)

# webshot::install_phantomjs()

dashboard <- read_csv("data/ca_dashboard.csv") %>%

         # color = as_factor(color),
         # color = fct_relevel(color, "0","1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
         leaname = if_else(is.na(charter_flag), districtname, schoolname),
         indicator = fct_relevel(as_factor(indicator), "ELA", "Math", "ELPI", "absenteeism", "graduation", "suspension", "college/career", "science"),
         leaname = fct_relevel(as_factor(leaname), "Solano County Office of Education",
                        "Benicia Unified",
                        "Dixon Unified",
                        "Fairfield-Suisun Unified",
                        "Travis Unified",
                        "Vacaville Unified",
                        "Vallejo City Unified",
                        "Buckingham Collegiate Charter Academy",

                        "Elite Public",

                        "Dixon Montessori Charter",
                        "Fairmont Charter Elementary",
                        "Griffin Academy High",
                        "Kairos Public",
                        "Mare Island Technology Academy",
                        "MIT Academy",
                        "MIT Griffin Academy Middle",
                        "Vallejo Charter"),
         lea_anonymous = case_match(leaname, 
                        "Solano County Office of Education" ~ "District A",
                        "Benicia Unified" ~ "District B",
                        "Dixon Unified" ~ "District C",
                        "Fairfield-Suisun Unified" ~ "District D",
                        "Travis Unified" ~ "District E",
                        "Vacaville Unified" ~ "District F",
                        "Vallejo City Unified" ~ "District G",
                        "Buckingham Collegiate Charter Academy" ~ "Charter A",
                        "Caliber: ChangeMakers Academy" ~ "Charter B",
                        "Elite Public" ~ "Charter C",
                        "Ernest Kimme Charter Academy" ~ "Charter D",
                        "Dixon Montessori Charter" ~ "Charter E",
                        "Fairmont Charter Elementary" ~ "Charter F",
                        "Griffin Academy High" ~ "Charter G",
                        "Kairos Public" ~ "Charter H",
                        "Mare Island Technology Academy" ~ "Charter I",
                        "MIT Academy" ~ "Charter J",
                        "MIT Griffin Academy Middle" ~ "Charter K",
                        "Vallejo Charter" ~ "Charter L"))


race_ethnicity_groups = c("Black/African American", "All students", "Filipino", "Hispanic", "Multiple Races/Two or more", "White", "American Indian or Alaska Native", "Asian", "Pacific Islander")

student_program_groups = c("All students", "English Learner", "Foster Youth",
                           "Homeless Youth", "Long-Term English Learner", 
                           "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged", "Students with Disabilities")

status_colors <- c("grey",
"tomato", "orange",
  "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue"
)

colors_only <- c("tomato", "orange",
  "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue"
)

font_add('fa-solid', 'fonts/fa-solid-900.ttf')

```

## Notes

The following graphics are using status levels and color calculated by Solano County Office of Education based on guidance from CDE to assist LEAs in understanding possible updates related to the science indicator on the CA Dashboard.

**All calculations such as science points, status level, change level, and color were not provided by CDE and should be treated as hypothetical.**

## Sources

Data is from the CDE CA Dashboard.

[Downloadable data files](https://www.cde.ca.gov/ta/ac/cm/dashboardresources.asp?tabsection=3)

Calculations are based on information in the following presentations:

[CDE: Updates to Accountability System March 5, 2025](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1EjIV-kdEt3wYkxVFcowvXsGVYmJQp0y8/edit?amp%3Bouid=112932094157258562194&amp%3Brtpof=true&amp%3Bsd=true&slide=id.p1#slide=id.p1)

[Region 4 Assessment Network: March 27, 2025](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1aA024QXF6dyNNGFpiuaNTOeB4lKwOVqmeJx6ChvcO_U/edit?slide=id.g24c1bafa518_0_284#slide=id.g24c1bafa518_0_284)

```{r calculate_color}
#| include: false

dashboard_sci_color <- 
  dashboard %>% 
  mutate(science_points = if_else(indicator == "science", currstatus + 64, NA)) %>%
  mutate(statuslevel = if_else(indicator == "science",
                 case_when(
                   science_points <= 34.9 ~ 1,
                   science_points >= 35 & science_points <= 44.9 ~ 2,
                   science_points >= 45 & science_points <= 54.9 ~ 3,
                   science_points >= 55 & science_points <= 64.9 ~ 4,
                   science_points >= 65 ~ 5,
                   .default = 0), 
                 statuslevel)) %>% 
  mutate(changelevel = if_else(indicator == "science",
                 case_when(
                   change <= -5.1 ~ 1,
                   change >= -5 & change <= -2 ~ 2,
                   change >= -1.9 & change <= 1.9 ~ 3,
                   change >= 2 & change <= 4.9 ~ 4,
                   change >= 5 ~ 5,
                   .default = 0),
                 changelevel)) %>% 
  mutate(color = if_else(indicator == "science",
                 case_when(
                   statuslevel == 0 | changelevel == 0 ~ 0,
                   statuslevel == 1 & changelevel <= 3 ~ 1,
                   statuslevel == 1 & changelevel >= 4 ~ 2,
                   statuslevel == 2 & changelevel <= 3 ~ 2,
                   statuslevel == 2 & changelevel >= 4 ~ 3,
                   statuslevel == 3 & changelevel <= 3 ~ 3,
                   statuslevel == 3 & changelevel >= 4 ~ 4,
                   statuslevel == 4 & changelevel <= 4 ~ 4,
                   statuslevel == 4 & changelevel == 5 ~ 5,
                   statuslevel == 5 & changelevel <= 2 ~ 4,
                   statuslevel == 5 & changelevel >= 3 ~ 5),
                 color)) %>% 
  mutate(color = as_factor(color),
         color = fct_relevel(color, "0","1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
         change = if_else(is.na(change), "", paste(change)),
         change_arrow = if_else(indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "science", "ELPI", 
                           "graduation", "college/career"),
                                case_match(changelevel, # improvement means up
                                   0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
                                   1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
                                   2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
                                   3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
                                   4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
                                   5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
                                   .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"),
                                  case_match(changelevel, # improvement means down
                                   0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
                                   5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
                                   4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
                                   3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
                                   2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
                                   1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
                                   .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>")))

dashboard_sci_color %>% 
  select(reportingyear, rtype, districtname, countyname, schoolname, student_group_long, charter_flag, 
         indicator, currstatus, science_points, statuslevel, changelevel, change, color) %>% 
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(file = "2024_dashboard_with_science_colors.xlsx")

```

## Science Status Cut Scores

| Status Level | Status Cut Scores            |
|--------------|------------------------------|
| Very Low     | 34.9 Science Points of Fewer |
| Low          | 35.0 to 44.9 Science Points  |
| Medium       | 45.0 to 54.9 Science Points  |
| High         | 55.0 to 64.9 Science Points  |
| Very High    | 65.0 Science Points or More  |

## Science Change Cut Scores

| Change Level            | Change Cut Score                             |
|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| Declined Significantly  | Declined by 5.1 points or more               |
| Declined                | Declined by 2.0 to 5.0 points                |
| Maintained              | Declined or increased by 1.9 points or fewer |
| Increased               | Increased by 2.0 to 4.9 points               |
| Increased Significantly | Increased by 5.0 points or more              |

## Scale Score Ranges for CAST

Science Points are calculated from lowest point value of level 1 which sets the lowest score to 0 for each grade.

| Grade            | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 |
|------------------|---------|---------|---------|---------|
| **Grade 5**      | 0-28    | 29-63   | 64-80   | 81-100  |
| **Grade 8**      | 0-27    | 28-64   | 65-82   | 83-100  |
| **Grades 10-12** | 0-25    | 26-64   | 65-85   | 86-100  |

## Science Point Equivalents for CAA

| Grade | Level 1 Science Point Equivalent | Level 2 Science Point Equivalent | Level 3 Science Point Equivalent |
|----|----|----|----|
| **Grade 5** | 28 | 63 | 80 |
| **Grade 8** | 27 | 64 | 82 |
| **Grades 10-12** | 25 | 64 | 85 |

## 2024 District Science Simulation by Race/Ethnicity

```{r science_colors_race_districts}
#| echo: false

showtext_auto()

dashboard_sci_color %>%
  filter(countyname == "Solano",
         indicator == "science",
         rtype == "D",
         student_group_long %in% race_ethnicity_groups) %>%
  mutate(student_group_long = str_wrap(student_group_long, 17)) %>% 
  arrange(rtype) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_richtext(x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
            mapping = aes(label = paste(science_points , change_arrow, change),
                          fill = color),
            show.legend = FALSE,
            text.color = "black",
            color = "darkgrey",
            label.size = 0.5,
            size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors,
                    drop = FALSE,
                    na.value = "white") +
  facet_grid(leaname ~ student_group_long, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 90, hjust = 0),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 11, angle = 0, vjust = 0.7, hjust = 0),
    strip.clip = "off",
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
  )

showtext_auto(FALSE)
```

  filter(countyname == "Solano",
         indicator == "science",

## Math and Science Scores

```{r math_science_points}
#| echo: false

dashboard_wide <- 
  dashboard_sci_color %>%
  filter(reportingyear == "2024") %>% 
  mutate(solano = countyname == "Solano",
         currstatus = if_else(indicator == "science", science_points, currstatus)) %>%
  arrange(solano) %>% 
  select(rtype, cds, solano, student_group_long, indicator, currstatus) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = indicator,
              values_from = currstatus) %>% 
    drop_na(Math, science) 

# Fit linear model
model <- lm(science ~ Math, data = dashboard_wide)
summary <- summary(model)

# Extract statistics
r_squared <- summary$r.squared
coefficient <- coef(model)[2]
p_value <- summary$coefficients[2, 4]

# Create annotation text
annotation_text <- sprintf("Coefficient = %.2f, R² = %.2f,\np-value = %e",
                          coefficient, r_squared, p_value)

# Plot with annotation
dashboard_wide %>%
  mutate(solano = if_else(solano, "Solano County LEA", "CA LEA outside of Solano County")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Math, y = science)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = solano)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("palegoldenrod", "darkred")) +
  labs(x = "Math scores (DFS)",
       y = "Science Points",
       color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  annotate("text", x = 200, y = 20, label = annotation_text, vjust = 1.1, hjust = 1)

```

## ELA and Science Scores

```{r ela_science_points}
#| echo: false

dashboard_wide <- 
  dashboard_sci_color %>%
  filter(reportingyear == "2024") %>% 
  mutate(solano = countyname == "Solano",
         currstatus = if_else(indicator == "science", science_points, currstatus)) %>%
  arrange(solano) %>% 
  select(rtype, cds, solano, student_group_long, indicator, currstatus) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = indicator,
              values_from = currstatus) %>% 
    drop_na(ELA, science) 

# Fit linear model
model <- lm(science ~ ELA, data = dashboard_wide)
summary <- summary(model)

# Extract statistics
r_squared <- summary$r.squared
coefficient <- coef(model)[2]
p_value <- summary$coefficients[2, 4]

# Create annotation text
annotation_text <- sprintf("Coefficient = %.2f, R² = %.2f,\np-value = %e",
                          coefficient, r_squared, p_value)

# Plot with annotation
dashboard_wide %>%
  mutate(solano = if_else(solano, "Solano County LEA", "CA LEA outside of Solano County")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ELA, y = science)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = solano)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("palegoldenrod", "darkred")) +
  labs(x = "ELA scores (DFS)",
       y = "Science Points",
       color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  annotate("text", x = 200, y = 20, label = annotation_text, vjust = 1.1, hjust = 1)

```

## Summary of linear regressions

Both Math and ELA CAASPP scores are positively associated with science scores. The slightly higher coefficient for ELA scores suggests a stronger effect size, while the higher $R^2$ for the ELA model indicates that ELA scores have a slightly greater predictive power at the LEA level. These findings underscore the importance of literacy skills on the CAST exam.
